title: Arc 1/5: add a deprecated-alias capability to the profile type system
summary: Net-new alias resolution, inert until a type is actually renamed.
description: Seed an alias map at profile.ts's single compile-loop site (751-752) so both byte-identical resolvers -- schema.ts:250 canonicalType and profile.ts:1032 canonicalProfileType -- pick it up for free. No type is renamed in this task; it ships inert and testable on its own.

acceptanceCriteria.text: An alias declared in a profile resolves to its canonical type through BOTH canonicalType and canonicalProfileType
profileTypeDeclaresField returns the canonical type's fields when given an alias, so lore link accepts an aliased document
An alias that collides with a declared type name or slug is rejected at profile compile time with a clear error
Mutation-tested: removing the alias lookup from ONE resolver reddens a predicted subset of cases, not all of them
npm run check exits 0 and lore check exits 0
